criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: User wants to play music, songs, albums, or playlists on a media service.

categories.name: Book Restaurant
categories.definition: User wants to reserve a table or book a restaurant for a specific time, location, or party size.

categories.name: Rate Media
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating, score, or star value to a book, album, or other media item.

categories.name: Find Creative Work
categories.definition: User wants to search for or locate a specific creative work such as a book, movie, game, show, or image.

categories.name: Get Weather
categories.definition: User wants to know the weather forecast or current conditions for a specific location and time.

categories.name: Add to Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a song, track, album, or artist to a specific music playlist.

categories.name: Get Movie Times
categories.definition: User wants to find movie showtimes or schedules at a specific theater or location.
